run.verdict_all_fair_other: All {{count}} cells that reported a level sit at fair. A sweep measures without the serving cell's help, and an indoor pass usually reads 10 to 15 dB below what the dashboard shows.

run.verdict_all_poor_other: All {{count}} cells that reported a level came back weak, so the whole table sits at the bottom of the ramp. A sweep measures without the serving cell's help, and an indoor pass usually reads 10 to 15 dB below what the dashboard shows — so this is not the same judgement as your own connection being weak.

states.error_banner: Can't reach the modem. These readings may be out of date.
states.stale_banner: Signal data is stale. The modem may be unresponsive.

unreachable.title: Can't reach the modem
unreachable.description: The antenna readings couldn't be loaded. Check that the poller service is running, then try again.

page.title: Antenna Alignment
page.description: Aim or reposition the antenna while watching the live score, then record up to three positions to compare them.

aim.title: Live Aim
aim.description: The primary receive chain, scored on the same scale as your recorded positions.
aim.description_live: The serving cell's signal as it moves, then the primary chain scored on the same scale as your recorded positions.
aim.no_reading: No aim score — the primary chain isn't reporting
aim.primary_chain: Main / PRX is the chain the score is built from

live.label: Serving RSRP
live.hint: The serving cell's signal across all receive chains, every second. In 5G NSA it is the LTE anchor, so it can differ from Main / PRX below.

recorder.title: Positions
recorder.description_directional: Record up to three angles and compare them. Each recording averages {{samples}} readings from the modem, which takes a few seconds.
recorder.description_omni: Record up to three placements and compare them. Each recording averages {{samples}} readings from the modem, which takes a few seconds.
recorder.not_comparable: No rankable reading, so this position can't be compared.
recorder.reset_confirm_body: Every position you've recorded will be deleted. This can't be undone.
recorder.clear_confirm_body: The reading recorded for {{label}} will be deleted. This can't be undone.
recorder.all_recorded_hint: All three positions are recorded. Clear one to record again.
recorder.recording_hint: Finish or cancel the recording in progress first.

recommendation.title: Best so far: {{label}}
recommendation.body_directional: This angle produced the strongest composite signal of the positions you've recorded.
recommendation.body_omni: This placement produced the strongest composite signal of the positions you've recorded.
recommendation.mixed_radios: Your recordings span both radios, so the comparison is rougher than usual.
recommendation.remaining: Record the remaining slots for a fuller comparison.

ports.title: Receive Chains
ports.description: Which antennas are contributing to the score.
ports.twin_hint: For per-metric detail on every chain, see

states.error_banner: Can't reach the modem. These readings may be out of date.
states.stale_banner: Signal data is stale. The modem may be unresponsive.

unreachable.title: Can't reach the modem
unreachable.description: The antenna readings couldn't be loaded. Check that the poller service is running, then try again.

no_readings.title: No antenna readings
no_readings.description: The modem answered, but no receive chain reported a measurement. It may be searching for a network, or an antenna may be disconnected — readings return on their own once a chain reports.

page.title: Cellular Basic Settings
page.description: Change how the modem uses its SIMs, its radio, and the networks it attaches to.
page.error_body: The values shown may be out of date.

sim_card.title: SIM & Radio Power
sim_card.description: Which SIM the modem uses, and whether the radio is powered.

network_card.title: Network Mode & Roaming
network_card.description: How the modem chooses a network to attach to.

cards.unread: Nothing was read from the modem, so there's nothing to change here yet.

sim_slot.label: SIM Slot
sim_slot.consequence: Switching slots drops the connection for about 15 seconds.

cfun.label: Radio Power
cfun.consequence: Radio off also powers down the SIM, Airplane keeps it powered, and the console stays reachable over Ethernet either way.

mode_pref.label: Preferred Network Type
mode_pref.consequence: Pin a technology only while troubleshooting.

nr5g_mode.label: 5G Architecture
nr5g_mode.consequence: Leave this on Auto unless your carrier requires standalone (5G on its own) or non-standalone (5G anchored to LTE).

roam_pref.label: Roaming Preference
roam_pref.consequence: Partner networks may be billed separately.

sim_detect.label: SIM Hot-Swap Detection
sim_detect.consequence: Without it, a swapped SIM goes unnoticed until the next reboot.

save_bar.note: Applying interrupts the connection briefly. The modem does not reboot.
save_bar.failed: Couldn't apply {{fields}}. Your other changes were saved.

apply.recovering: Waiting for the radio to settle

strip.label: Live state
strip.unavailable_retrying: The last read failed. QManager is still trying.

rate_ceiling.eyebrow: Rate ceiling granted by the network
rate_ceiling.provenance: Rate limits are ceilings the network grants, not measured speed. They are read when the page opens and again after each save.
rate_ceiling.unavailable: The last read failed. Use "Re-read from modem" below to try again.

ambr.nsa_note: 5G non-standalone runs over the LTE data session, so this limit applies.
ambr.lte_empty_reason: The modem publishes an LTE limit only while an LTE data session is up.
ambr.nr_empty_reason: The modem publishes a 5G limit only while a 5G data session is up.
ambr.governing_unread: Your connection uses this radio. No limit was read for it when the page opened.

page.title: APN Settings
page.description: Set the APN, IP protocol, and data context your SIM uses to connect.

card.title: APN Configuration
card.description: The Access Point Name the modem uses to establish a data connection.

dialog.title: Use carrier default APN?
dialog.description: Your carrier will choose the APN automatically. The cellular connection will drop briefly while the modem reconnects.

apn.label: APN
apn.error_invalid: Use only letters, numbers, dots, hyphens and underscores (up to 100 characters)
apn.consequence: The name your carrier gives for mobile data.

pdp_type.label: PDP Type
pdp_type.consequence: Which IP versions the connection asks for.

modem_profile.label: CID
modem_profile.consequence: The modem context that carries your data.

cid_confirm.title: Use a reserved context?
cid_confirm.description_ims: CID {{cid}} is reserved by your carrier for IMS (VoLTE / Wi-Fi calling). Writing a data APN here can disrupt voice calling. Continue anyway?
cid_confirm.description_sos: CID {{cid}} is reserved for emergency (SOS) calling. Writing a data APN here can disrupt emergency calls. Continue anyway?

card.title: Carrier Profile
card.description: Choose the carrier firmware profile the modem runs; changes need a reboot.

auto_select.label: Auto-Select Profile
auto_select.consequence: The modem picks the profile that matches your SIM.

configuration.label: Carrier Configuration
configuration.auto_hint: Turn off auto-select to choose a profile.
configuration.empty_body: The modem didn't list any carrier profiles.

reboot_dialog.title: Reboot Required
reboot_dialog.description: Carrier profile changes require a device reboot to take effect. Would you like to reboot now?

toast.reboot_error: Reboot failed — restart the device manually

errors.load_failed: The modem didn't answer with its carrier profiles. Try again in a moment.
errors.save_failed: Couldn't apply the carrier profile setting.

apn.profile_gate_title: The {{profile}} Custom SIM Profile manages your APN
apn.profile_gate_note: Edit that profile to change these settings.

errors.load_failed: The modem didn't answer with its APN settings. Try again in a moment.
errors.deactivate_failed: Couldn't switch to the carrier default APN.

readout.not_live_note: The network is using a different APN than the one saved.

page.title: IMEI Settings
page.description: Read, write and verify the identifier the modem presents to the network.
page.error_title: Could not read the IMEI settings

legal.title: IMEI modification is regulated in most countries
legal.body: Writing an identifier you do not own is an offence in many jurisdictions. Check your local law before you change anything on this page.

banner.title: A reboot is needed to apply the new IMEI
banner.description: The identifier is written. The modem still presents the old one until it restarts.

dialog.title: Restart to apply the new IMEI
dialog.description: The IMEI is stored, but the modem keeps presenting the old one until it restarts. Restarting drops the connection for about a minute.

reboot.toast_failed: Couldn't start the reboot. It is still pending, so you can retry from the banner.

device.title: Device IMEI
device.description: What the modem reports now, and what it will report after the next boot.

write.label: Write new IMEI
write.consequence: 15 digits. Takes effect only after a reboot.

errors.length: An IMEI is exactly 15 digits. You have entered {{entered}}.
errors.luhn: These 15 digits fail the check-digit test, so the network will reject them. Change the last digit, or generate a valid number in IMEI Tools.

status.empty: Nothing to write. The field is empty.
status.unchanged: This is already the IMEI on the modem.
status.ready: Ready to write. The modem keeps its current identity until it reboots.

toasts.saved: IMEI written. It applies at the next reboot.
toasts.failed: The modem did not accept that IMEI.

backup.title: Backup IMEI
backup.description: A second identifier the device restores if the primary is lost after a firmware event.

keep.label: Keep a backup
keep.consequence_off: Off. No backup identifier is stored.
keep.consequence_on: On. The device restores {{imei}} if the primary is rejected.

value.label: Backup identifier
value.consequence: 15 digits. Used only if the primary is rejected.

errors.length: An IMEI is exactly 15 digits. You have entered {{entered}}.
errors.luhn: These 15 digits fail the check-digit test, so the network would reject the backup too. Change the last digit, or generate a valid number in IMEI Tools.

toasts.failed: Could not save the backup settings.

dialog.title: About backup recovery
dialog.description: With a backup stored, the device checks after each reboot whether the network rejected its IMEI. If it did, the device switches to the backup identifier and restarts on its own.

tools.title: IMEI Tools
tools.description: Generate a Luhn-valid number from a type allocation code, or check one you already have.

generate.tac_consequence: The first eight digits, which name the model the number claims to be.
generate.prefix_consequence: 8 to 12 digits. Everything after them is filled in for you.
generate.prefix_error: A prefix is 8 to 12 digits. You have entered {{entered}}.

check.label: Check a number
check.empty: Enter 15 digits to see how the number is built.

tools.footnote: Valid structure does not mean the number is yours to use. Nothing here is written to the modem.

page.title: Network Priority
page.description: The order the modem tries radio technologies when it registers.

card.title: Acquisition Order
card.description: Drag to reorder. The modem re-registers when you save, which drops the connection for a few seconds.

position.first: Tried first. Falls back automatically when no cell answers here.
position.middle: Tried next when nothing above it registers.
position.last: Last resort. Used only when nothing above it registers.
position.only: The only technology the modem will try.

save_bar.note: The modem re-registers on save. Expect about 3 seconds without data.

error.title: Couldn't read the priority order
error.description: The modem didn't answer the acquisition-order query. It may be busy — try again in a moment.

empty.title: No technologies reported
empty.description: The modem returned an empty acquisition order, so there is nothing to rank. Re-read it, or check that the radio is on.

page.title: Blocked Networks
page.description: Your SIM stores a list of networks that previously rejected this device. Clearing it can restore connectivity and improve roaming.
page.note: Clearing writes to the SIM, not the modem, and nothing reboots. The list rebuilds itself if a network rejects the device again.

card.title: Forbidden Network List
card.description: QManager reads this list straight from the SIM each time you open this page.

loading.title: Checking the SIM
loading.description: Reading the forbidden network list stored on the card.

clean.title: No blocked networks
clean.description: The SIM has nothing on its forbidden list. No action needed.

entries.title: Blocked networks found
entries.description: The SIM is refusing one or more networks, which can keep the modem from attaching. Clearing the list is recommended.

unknown.title: Status unknown
unknown.description: QManager could not determine whether this SIM has blocked networks. Nothing was changed — try reading it again.

confirm.title: Clear the blocked network list?
confirm.description: This erases the forbidden network list stored on the SIM card and cannot be undone. Nothing reboots and the modem stays connected. The list rebuilds itself if a network rejects this device again.

errors.read_failed: The device could not read the SIM's forbidden network list.

summary.rest_of_day: in force for the rest of today
